core.title: Solid Brass Sierra Villa Door Knocker, Omnia 79

text.description_html:
Omnia Sierra Villa Door Knocker

Omnia's Solid Brass Sierra Villa Door Knocker has a decidedly retro feel, with all the glitz and glamor of the Roaring 20s. Its unique shape brings makes it stand-out. It is made out of polished brass with a hand polished finish. After it is polished, a hard and transparent lacquer is baked on. This special process retains the tradition of old world excellence while employing the best available modern technology to protect and preserve your fine taste. Available in a 5-1/16 inch height and a 5-7/8 inch height.

Available in 2 different sizes:

    OMN-79/60
    • Overall Size: 5-1/16"
    • Center to center: 2-5/8"
    • Projection: 1-3/4"
    • US3 Polished Brass Finish
    OMN-79/80
    • Overall Size: 5-7/8"
    • Center to center: 3-3/16"
    • Projection: 2-5/8"
    • US3 Polished Brass Finish
